The final baseline comparison returns zero failures and distinguishes preserved predecessor exclusions from admitted closeout-document changes.
All files under scripts/foreground_stdio remain byte-identical and all 16 controller tests pass.
All files under scripts/task_start_scope_baseline remain byte-identical and all 17 focused baseline tests pass with only platform-limited skips.
The controller task, baseline task, their historical evidence, retained consumer and build evidence, Core source, product tests, public CLI, package, Adapter, and MCP implementation remain unchanged.

A new closeout evidence file records exact commands, results, baseline counts, privacy boundary, bootstrap lineage, and remaining unknowns without raw source, patch, output, absolute path, credential, process identifier, or host identity.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-ec752a36318d42058207f2559d565a06 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Perform the first baseline-backed closeout review of the already implemented repository-internal foreground STDIO controller. After human take-up, capture the admitted task boundary before any repository write, preserve all controller and baseline-tool implementation artifacts, rerun their declared validation, and write new bounded closeout evidence. This task may establish REVIEW_READY_BASELINE_BACKED for product review; it must not retroactively claim the original controller task passed its historical cumulative scope command or authorize a Codex retry.

items: Any repository write before capture would invalidate the review boundary and must stop the task.
Changing an excluded controller, baseline-tool, historical-evidence, source, or test path must fail the baseline comparison.
Including preserved predecessor task records for complete dirty-worktree classification must not be treated as permission to edit them.
A successful differential comparison could be misrepresented as retroactive success of the original cumulative scope command.
The local baseline contains path and digest metadata and must remain local and unexported.
A task, HEAD, layer, endpoint, or capture-stability drift must fail closed.
Native task-completion recording is unavailable in the current tool surface and cannot be fabricated.
Reviewed assumption: The admitted task record exists before execution and the baseline capture can run immediately after human take-up.
Reviewed assumption: The internal baseline tool and controller remain available exactly as validated in their predecessor tasks.
Reviewed assumption: Local .agentgov baseline state is excluded from canonical untracked snapshots.
Reviewed assumption: A baseline-backed review-ready result is useful even though native completion integration is not yet implemented.
Reviewed assumption: All task-included predecessor task records remain byte-identical despite being included only to classify the preserved dirty worktree.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the product owner will accept REVIEW_READY_BASELINE_BACKED as sufficient controller closeout is not yet decided.
Reviewed unknown: Public CLI and development-session integration remain deferred.
Reviewed unknown: Real Codex framing and shutdown compatibility remain unknown.
Reviewed unknown: Causal benefit, saved review time, and return on investment remain unknown.
